subject: Vendr profile: ownership confirmation & temporary credential scope
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cloudbridge.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, support@vendr.com
Cc: security@cloudbridge.com
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr profile access + who is the evidence custodian?

Hi Olga and Vendr team,

We're kicking off our security intake for Redwood Inference as part of our renewal. Can you confirm who at Redwood will be listed as the \"profile custodian\" in Vendr and whether temporary upload credentials will be scoped to a single S3 bucket or multiple buckets? Our audit requires an owner and a narrow temp-credential scope to reduce blast radius.

I've attached a short intake matrix we use (vendr_intake_matrix.xlsx) — fill the owner and upload path columns and upload the files to the Vendr evidence area. We also need a short note describing how temp credentials are generated and rotated.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Security Engineer
Cloudbridge Inc.
Attachments: vendr_intake_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr profile access + who is the evidence custodian?

Hi Maria — thanks for the matrix. I'm Olga; I'll own the Vendr profile for this engagement. Quick notes: 

- Profile custodian (internal): Olga Petrov, Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference.
- Temporary credential approach: we scope uploads to an auditable S3 prefix per-account (s3://redwood-vendr/cloudbridge/*) and issue short-lived STS tokens limited to PutObject and ListBucket on that prefix. Rotation is automated by our keybroker; tokens expire after 15 minutes.

I'll populate your matrix and upload the initial evidence bundle by Monday. Ben / Jonas — can you confirm we have the right S3 prefix and that the automation will emit an upload event for the evidence manifest? Also tagging request: please tag objects with \"vendr_evidence=true\" so we can produce proofs.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr profile access + who is the evidence custodian?

Got it — confirming the bucket/prefix and automation: 

- Bucket: redwood-evidence-prod
- Prefix: cloudbridge/cloudbridge-vendr-uploads/  (we'll map that to s3://redwood-evidence-prod/cloudbridge/cloudbridge-vendr-uploads/)
- Automation: an S3 event triggers the evidence-ingest lambda that writes an evidence manifest to DynamoDB and emits a CloudTrail-backed proof record. We will add a one-off manifest field to include the Vendr upload ID so they can cross-reference.

I'll add the vendr_evidence tag as part of the upload workflow.

Jonas — can you schedule the Vendr upload (API) on Monday morning? We should include the manifest.csv + SOC2-attestation.pdf + a short tempcreds scope note. I've attached a quick tempcreds_scope_notes.txt with the proposed wording.

- Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: tempcreds_scope_notes.txt
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cloudbridge.com>, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr profile access + who is the evidence custodian?

Hi Maria — quick update: evidence bundle uploaded to the Vendr profile this morning.

What we uploaded (Vendr evidence area ID: VENDR-39481):
- manifest.csv (keys + checksums)
- SOC2_Attestation_Redwood_2026Q3.pdf
- tempcreds_scope_notes.txt (short explanation of STS process and 15-minute expiry)

Olga is listed as the profile custodian in Vendr, and we've scoped the temp creds to s3://redwood-evidence-prod/cloudbridge/cloudbridge-vendr-uploads/* with object tagging enabled. Vendr upload link: https://app.vendr.com/companies/cloudbridge/profile/evidence/VENDR-39481

Maria — can you confirm receipt and whether the manifest format meets Cloudbridge's intake policy, or if you need any additional proofs (CloudTrail snippet, KMS key id, or signed manifest)?
